title: The workout import reads files with an old spreadsheet library that has two known high-rated flaws
what: Bring in past workouts reads a Hevy or Strong export picked by the member, or a file shared into the app from another app such as WhatsApp, with spreadsheet library version 0.18.5. That version has two high-rated known flaws: a crafted file can change how the app's own objects behave, or make the reading freeze. The library's npm copy will never get a fix; the web panel already moved to the maker's fixed build (0.20.3).
expected: The phone app reads spreadsheet files with a version past both fixes (0.20.2 or newer), as the panel already does.
how_often: only when a crafted file is imported
fix_line: Switch the phone app to the spreadsheet maker's own fixed build, as the panel did

items.reason: The area defines no server route or database function (items list: 0). Its screens call, through the shop folder: the WhatsApp number check and the lead form (public by design, the Worker checks them), and member_find_gyms, member_claim_phone and member_measurements, which anyone may run but each checks a WhatsApp proof or the member's own key inside. The j/ and c/ screens only re-export the shop screens.

Apps cannot read: the tables these screens reach (trainer measurements, gym members, phone links, gyms) have row rules on and no rule for app users except the gyms read rule tied to a signed-in gym; security.sql reads every table as an app user and fails on any row. Other-gym refusal: measurements 0035 check 6z (a same-number member of another gym gets nothing); number link 0068 check 8 (a number not on this gym's list is refused); membership 0023 check 7; gym pack 0046 check 2.
Rule applied: every table this area reaches has an other-gym or apps-cannot-read test; no table without one.
Rule applied: no live cross-gym attempt was run.
No key pattern hits in these screens; the only fixed addresses are the public number-check and lead-form addresses (in the shop folder), not secrets.
No AI or payment key in this area. The AI coach and nutrition screens are switched off and send the member back to the Workout tab; the AI calls live in the chat store, outside this area.

No sign-in or PIN in this area. Find my gym's WhatsApp proof is kept in memory only, for 15 minutes; the server refuses expired, wrong-purpose or forged proofs and allows at most 5 searches per proof (test 0068 checks 4 and 5).

No screen here builds a database query from text; workout search uses placeholders and escapes % and _. The profile link only accepts http or https web links, so tapping it cannot run another kind of link. Text sent to the server goes as call arguments. All text is drawn as plain text.

Nothing here uploads. The import reads the picked or shared file on the phone and deletes the cached copy after; the profile photo is copied into the app's own folder; the coach photo picker is switched off. The file reader is the old spreadsheet library: new finding.

The invite link /j/<code> carries the gym's 6-character join code, which can be found by trying codes: already found. The check-in link /c/<code> only works for a member already holding that gym's key. Links from other hosts are ignored.
The phone app's spreadsheet library 0.18.5 has 2 high alerts and is used by the import screen here: new finding. No ongoing library check: already found.
